notes.title: Rodent Warriors v 0.8.4.0 now live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

A new release is finally here! Hooray! This is one of our biggest updates ever, so we hope that you have fun with it. Here is what went into the latest version:


Four new question locations!

Beach
City
Cave
Cruise Ship

Joystick support!

Can play game from end to end with a joystick, no mouse or keyboard input required!
Fully configurable controls
Visual representation of which joystick buttons are mapped to which actions
Try playing with a joystick it's a blast!

Leveling up is no longer forced, you can now decide when to spend your level points!
Added back the auto level up, auto craft items, and auto manage relic strategy options
Musical themes for all question locations completed
New countries on the map, new anthems
UI improvements and a few presentation changes
Probably other bug fixed and things that we forgot already

notes.title: Rodent Warriors v 0.8.1 now live
notes.content:
Well hello!

Yes I know, we just released a version a short time ago. But we just HAD to include these changes:


The New Quest System

Quests are now grouped by Army Rank
Enemy difficulty increases depending on the location
The quest that allows you to advance to the next Army Rank will be the 
most difficult quest in the series
The Quest Selection Screen has been updated to reflect the changes



We have been searching for a way to add a sense of progression to the game and we hope that this change will address this wish.

In order to access new areas on the map, players will have to defeat previous areas first. This won't be a hard rule, but will be dictated by the Enemy level in each area.

Once your Heroes get more powerful, you can bypass areas and go straight to wherever you like!

Once we have all of the backgrounds and enemies done, we will also be able to introduce enemies slowly into the game, so that not everything is available at once.

As always have fun playing and stay tuned for more updates!

Kevin

notes.title: Rodent Warriors v 0.6.0.0 now live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Hope you've been having fun. Guess what? Version 0.6.0.0 is now live! Hooray!

Here is a list of all of the changes (that we can remember)


Achievements!

There are now 180 Achievements in the game. See if you can win 'em all!

Dialogues have been removed.

After many attempts at making some sort of Dialogue system that wasn't boring and repetitive we finally decided to just remove Dialogues entirely. Who needs 'em!

Quests are now Missions for the Rodent Army.

You now perform Missions for the Rodent Army which progress to various areas of the map as you gain ranks in the Army.
Not all of the background artwork is complete so you can expect many more locations to appear in the coming months.

Mouse's Fear now grants a very short but large move speed bonus and has a percentage change to send nearby enemies running away in Fear!
Remove the yellow Help buttons and made the Options button smaller.

These buttons were taking up too much valuable UI real estate. An upcoming will instead have a digital manual available via the Mobile device.

You can now carry a maximum of 32 Ancient Relics!
Fixed some screen scaling issues.
Fixed some Rodent face display issues.
Replaced the Fanfares that play when you do certain things.

notes.title: Rodent Warriors v 0.5 in Beta!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It's been a while since our last post. We're baaaack!

Rodent Warriors v 0.5 is now available in Beta.

Here is a breakdown of the changes for this latest version:


 Quest Mazes are now 10 x 10
 The Mini map no longer scrolls
 Hardcore mode added (can't use Strategy mode)
 Magic Juice now increases stats by 25% per juice
 Super bosses are now Epic bosses which are larger and even more powerful
 Epic bosses don't spawn as part of the normal Quest enemies
 Once all quest objectives are complete the Epic Boss for the area is spawned. When it is defeated the Quest is completed
 Added Collect quests in addition to Find quests. Collect quests involve picking up items around the maze
 Found and collected items are now removed from the maze once found / collected
 Added Grassland mini map tiles
 Added some new Collect quest items
 Health and Mana regeneration is now greatly increased after 10 seconds out of Combat
 Porcupine now only loses Mana after 5 seconds out of Combat
 The order of unlocking Rodents starting from Level 1 has changed
 Strategy and Pantheon panels have been moved into the new Diary panel
 Added an Intro story screen after naming your character
 Changed / fixed the Credits screen
 Fixed mobile notification bug where multiple texts appeared at once


Please try it out and let us know what you think.

Thanks again for playing and we will see you soon!

Kevin

notes.title: Rodent Warriors v 0.4 - beta
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

It's been a while since our last post. Sorry about that! 

We have been busy working on Rodent Warriors and have a new beta version ready for testing!

Here are the details.

Gameplay

The way that Legacy Bonuses, Skill and Item Levels interact has changed
Upon reincarnation, skill and item crafting levels are now retained up to a maximum level determined by the Rat and Weasel legacy bonuses
Skill % Bonuses and Challenges now instead affect the cost for increasing Skill Levels
Item Crafting Level % Bonuses and Challenges now instead affect the cost for increasing Item Crafting Levels
Base cost to increase Skill level is now level / 2
Base cost to increase Item crafting level is now level / 2

Enemies

 Enemy stats are being reworked to make progression more stable

Items

 Symbols are now one time use - once a recipe has been completed the Symbols can't be removed

Skills

Beaver 

 Double Image now blocks less damage

Capybara 

 Behemoth now provides less health boost

Mouse

 Guided Strike is now Shadow Strike! Dashes to nearest enemies dealing damage before dashing back to the original position

Strategy

 Rodent Select strategy can now be set
 Strategy mode can now use runes in items
 Strategy mode can now manage Ancient Relics
 Strategy mode tries to be smarter in combat than before

Bug Fixes

 Fixed bug where Pantheon dates for Hero were always the same day
 Fixed bug where projectiles were missing
 Improved Skeleton's walking formation
 Fixed buff icon's size issue (hopefully)


As always keep having fun!

We would like to hear from you. Join our Discord server to follow along with the game's development.

https://discord.gg/hUvQ55K

Kevin

notes.title: Rodent Warriors v 0.3 is live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I bet you thought this day would never come. Or maybe you didn't... but either way here we are!

This release represents the largest amount of changes we have made to the game in one batch. So please let us know how it is working out for you.

As always we would love to hear from you. So join our Discord server and give us your thoughts, ideas, complaints, etc.

https://discord.gg/hUvQ55K

Here is the (mostly) complete list of the changes that went into this version.

Enemies now have their own abilities!

Charging - Charges at the hero at a fast speed from a long distance away doing damage on impact
Ranged - Attacks from range with projectiles
Sneaky - Will move from one side of the Hero to the other in order to surround the Hero
Protector - Takes less damage and blocks abilities that do damage in a line
Powerful - A special attack with more damage and less accuracy							
Focused - A special attack with more accuracy but less damage
Berserker - Performs three quick attacks
Reviver - Brings defeated enemies back into the battle!	
Poisonous - A special attack that drains the Hero's health over time
Bomber - Launches a projectile into the air that damages the Hero when it hits the ground
Healer - Heals damaged enemies 
	
Skills

 Weasel bomb now only counts down from 2
 Rat Soul Leech and Blood Pact swapped places
 Soul Leech now instantly does damage and drains health

UI

There is now a Pantheon in the Mobile Device to view past Heroes
   Heroes played up to this point won't show their Face and Challenges but subsequent ones will	
The Auto Play options have been moved into the Strategy screen on the mobile device

Misc

Enemies now have different sizes and collide accordingly
Crafting multiple items in a row is now easier
Notification appears when you can craft items
Camera now shakes when Hero takes damage from a Boss

Bug Fixes

Fixed Weasel bomb text bug
Fixed Rodent Select screen story not starting at top
Fixed black vertical lines bug


Keep having fun! There will be more to come...

Kevin

notes.title: Rodent Warriors V 0.1.5 plans
notes.content:
Hi again!

I want to share with you our plans for V 0.1.5.

We released Rodent Warriors into Early Access with some things left unfinished (duh). One of the things we want to do is change the static nature of the enemies into something more dynamic.

For this version we want to get the enemies moving in the maze! We know that this is going to change the game-play and hopefully it will be in a good way.

This should be only a minor amount of work. But it is important because it is leading up to what will give the enemies some real character: enemy abilities!

To be clear, the enemy abilities won't be in V 0.1.5, but this is what we are thinking in terms of abilities:

Every type of enemy will have one ability.
The abilities that a type of enemy has will be taken from this list:

Charge (from far away and fast)
Ranged Attack
Change Sides (e.g. moves from the left of the hero to the right)
Tank mode - the enemy temporarily takes less damage.
Enraged mode - the enemy temporarily does more damage
Berserk mode - the enemy temporarily attacks faster
Stun attack



As always we would love to hear what you think!

In the meantime have fun playing!

Kevin

notes.title: Rodent Warriors V0.2 plans
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

How's it going?

Did you know that Rodent Warriors has quest dialogues? Probably not because they are disabled right now. :-)

Originally Rodent Warriors was developed with Quest stories as just a big wall o' text. But no one wants to read a big wall o' text! (Note to self... cut down the length of this release announcement)

Our plan for v 0.2 is to turn back on the Quest dialogues. This is what we hope to achieve.

Tell a compelling story.
Let the player interact with character(s) the way that they want to.
Make people laugh.


This release might take a little longer because well.. writing is hard!

For this release our goal is to create dialogues for interacting with the Rodent King. We will gradually introduce other characters as we have time to write the interactions.

Of course we will continue to make small improvements and bug fixes as we go.

As always we are open to ideas and feedback from our community.

Thanks again for listening and have fun playing!

Kevin

notes.title: Rodent Warriors V 0.1.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Hopefully you are enjoying playing Rodent Warriors!

We have a number of things that we are working on that are going to take some more time. Plus we have been very busy preparing for our Steam launch.

Still we want to keep the game constantly improving, and so we have a very small release planned around giving the enemies more personality.


Enemies will now have a category. Each category will give enemies a bonus to their stats.

Tanky => Max Heakth
Vicious => Damage
Speedster => Move Speed
Hyper => Attack Speed
Hardened => Defense
Accurate => Attack Accuracy

Enemies will now only spawn in correct locations on the globe. e.g. Elephants only in Asia or Africa.


The next steps to giving enemies personality will be have them move around the maze, and to give them abilities. We have some ideas around this, but don't have a timeline for when it will be ready.

Also we would love to hear from you. Please give us your ideas and / or feedback in the Community Section. Or contacts us at:

Twitter: @RodentWarriors
email: rodentwarriorsgame@gmail.com
